ordering_note: CARBON-FIXATION KCAT (the phototroph's key uncertainty, analog of the methanogen Mcr sweep): SS-E stays in [0.565, 0.577] across RuBisCO 0.5-4x and Calvin 0.5-2x -- essentially INVARIANT (<0.03 eV), and always well below E. coli (0.6784) and the methanogen (1.0558). So the low phototroph Ea is a curvature/SHAPE property of its low-E controlling enzymes, NOT a kcat-level artefact -> ORDERING (photosynthesis < respiration < methanogenesis) is ROBUST to the phototroph's own kinetic uncertainty. The MMRT dCp prior (-2..-6 kJ/mol/K -> SS-E 0.29..0.79) is the SHARED Hobbs-2013 curvature applied to ALL THREE organisms; it scales the whole comparison together and is a common systematic, not a reordering lever (breaking the order would need a phototroph-SPECIFIC curvature steepening, which is unmotivated).
